name: Super Sticky
summary: In Gadgetzan, Tran'rek sees quick gold in super sticky glue. He needs tar from beasts near the pits in northern Un'Goro Crater and offers a little of the profit.

sections.title: A Sticky Idea
sections.body: Tran'rek hopes his newest idea will bring quick gold, and offers you a little of the profit. Ordinary tar is not sticky enough. He wants twelve samples from creatures near the tar pits in northern Un'Goro Crater.

sections.title: Why the Beasts
sections.body: The plant-like creatures around the pits have chlorophyll in their skin. Mixed with tar, it makes a super sticky glue.

sections.title: Once the Tar Arrives
sections.body: When Tran'rek handles the tar, his hands soon stick together. He changes his plan on the spot. A super sticky tar remover, he decides, is where the real money lies.

faq.q: Who asks for the sticky tar?
faq.answer: Tran'rek in Gadgetzan asks for the sticky tar.

faq.q: Why does the tar have to come from beasts?
faq.answer: Ordinary tar is not sticky enough. The plant-like creatures around the tar pits have chlorophyll in their skin, which makes the tar super sticky.
The tar beasts live by the tar pits in northern Un'Goro Crater.

faq.q: What does Tran'rek plan to do with the tar?
faq.answer: Tran'rek plans to make super sticky glue for quick gold and offers a little of the profit to whoever helps.
